visual.general_description: Line graph with markers of the natural log of serum quetiapine concentration against time in hours.
visual.detailed_description: A single red line with circular markers is drawn in a bordered plot area with light horizontal gridlines on a white background. The y-axis title reads Natural Log of Quetiapine serum concentration (µg/mL) and the printed ticks are -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2. The x-axis title reads Time (Hour) and the printed ticks run from 00:00 to 66:00 in 06:00 steps. Seven markers are joined by straight segments: the line falls across the first several markers, rises between two later markers, and then falls again to the last marker. No legend, data labels, panel letters or arrows are printed.

visual.general_description: Line graph with markers of urine quetiapine concentration against time in hours.
visual.detailed_description: A single yellow line with circular markers is drawn in a bordered plot area with light horizontal gridlines on a white background. The y-axis title is printed as Quetiapine urine comcentration (µg/mL) and the printed ticks are 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35. The x-axis title reads Time (Hour) and the printed category labels are Admission, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 and 72. Seven markers are joined by straight segments, one per category label: the line rises from the first marker to the second, falls, rises slightly, and then falls across the last three markers. No legend, data labels, panel letters or arrows are printed.
